 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for the State on I.A. No. 02 of 2022 which has been filed to suspend the sentence and stay the fine and release the appellant on bail.

The present appeal has been filed against the judgment of conviction dated 06.06.2017 and order of sentence dated 12.06.2017 passed by the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, I,
Kishanganj in connection with Sessions Trial No. 145 of 2009 whereby and whereunder the appellant has been convicted for the offences punishable under Section 376 and 323 of the I.P.C.
and accordingly the appellant has sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years and a fine of Rs. 20,000/-

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that earlier bail was rejected on 03.08.2017 on merit.
Thereafter appellant preferred I.A. No. 305 of 2018 and vide order dated 12.02.2018 the same was also rejected by co-ordinate bench.
Now prior to conviction, the appellant was in custody since 05.01.2009 to 13.03.2009 thereafter, since the date of conviction i.e. 06.06.2017 he is in custody.
Total period of custody undergone by the appellant is near about 6 years which is more than half of the punishment.

From perusal of the initial version of prosecution, it is crystal clear that the refusal of the offer of marriage resulted in filing of the present case and it has been submitted that the appellant bears no criminal history prior to Patna High Court CR.
dt.23-03-2023 this occurrence
. Appeal is not likely to be heard in near future.
Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposes the prayer for bail of the appellant and submits that judgment is just and fair on the basis of evidence adduced by the prosecution witnesses.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, period of custody has already undergone by the appellant, appeal is not likely to be heard in near future, argument advanced on behalf of the appellant and materials available on record, in the opinion of this Court it will be proper to enlarge the appellant on bail during pendency of the appeal.
Accordingly, I.A. No. 02/2022 is allowed and the appellant above-named is directed to be enlarged on bail during pendency of the appeal on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousands) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional District and Sessions Judge, I, Kishanganj in connection with Sessions Trial No. 145 of 2009.
Sentence of the appellants is suspended during the pendency of the appeal and realization of fine shall also remain stayed during the pendency of the appeal.
Accordingly, I.A. No. 02 of 2022 stands disposed of.
Patna High Court CR.
The appellant is directed co-operate this Court in disposal of the appeal.
Office is directed to list this case under appropriate heading.

(Alok Kumar Pandey, J) amitkr/-
